what: Funds that are not rows of the sector ladder but get a look-through SEC composite from basket_fundamentals.py (payload key extra_rows of data/rotation_fundamentals.json). same_book_as: the fund tracks the same index as that ladder row, so its composite is that row's. nport: the composite is built from the fund's own latest SEC N-PORT book, which rotation_members.py lists weekly beside the top-10 rows. Add a fund by adding a line; nothing else is needed.
